topic: Getting a Bike Fixed at a Shop

script.title: AT THE BIKE REPAIR SHOP
script.scene_zh: 腳踏車行 · 送車維修
script.story_hook: A rider brings in one flat tire too many.
script.intro_zh: 騎士帶著老是漏氣的腳踏車，進維修店求救。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're getting a bike fixed.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天我們要去修腳踏車。
script.outro: Bike booked, problem solved! Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 車子收下、問題解決！再聽一次，一起跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat these repair shop lines.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟讀這些修車店會用的句子。

script.char_b_description: a wiry man in his late forties with a greying beard tucked under a backwards cap, wearing a navy mechanic jumpsuit tied at the waist, wiping his hands on a rag

script.youtube_title_en: "Squeaks Like Crazy" — Getting a Bike Fixed at the Shop
script.youtube_description:
腳踏車老漏氣、煞車又叫，用英文怎麼跟技師說？這段車行裡的維修對話，教你描述問題、問修理費與時間、安排送車到家。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能自己報修。

訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！

Flat tire again, and the brakes are screaming? This bike shop visit teaches you how to describe the problem, ask what it costs, and agree on a pickup time. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and Traditional Chinese, then a repeat-after-me section so the words stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚲修腳踏車英文｜描述漏氣・問修理費・約取車時間｜聽完就會修｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
腳踏車一直漏氣，要用英文怎麼描述？
煞車會尖叫、還需要保養，怎麼問？
報價與取車時間，又該怎麼確認？

這一集帶大家走進一間滿是零件的腳踏車行，跟著騎士從說明問題、聽懂工資，到確認要換一條煞車線、改叫配送，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
🛞 說明問題：例如「my back tire goes flat every week.」、「my front brake squeaks like crazy.」。
💵 問價位：例如「How much is a new tube around here?」、「A tune-up is forty-five.」。
⏱️ 確認時間與安全：例如「how long will all of this take, though?」、「Is it safe to ride it home today?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把維修店的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次推著車進車行，你也能把狀況說得清清楚楚！
script.thumbnail_action: wheeling in a bike with a flat back tire

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my back tire goes flat every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ bæk ˈtaɪər ɡoʊz flæt ˈɛvri wik/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的後輪每個星期都會漏氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see it. Any glass in the tread?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si ɪt ˈɛni ɡlæs ɪn ðə trɛd/
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看。胎面上有玻璃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I saw a tiny wire there last time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ sɔ ə ˈtaɪni ˈwaɪər ðɛr læst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 上週我好像看到一根很細的鐵絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That'll do it. We'll patch it and replace the tube.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðætəl du ɪt wil pætʃ ɪt ənd rɪˈpleɪs ðə tub/
dialogue.zh: 那就是原因了。我們會補胎，再換內胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a new tube around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə nju tub əˈraʊnd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在你們這裡換一個內胎大概多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen with labor, and that's the honest price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪftiən wɪð ˈleɪbər ənd ðæts ði ˈɑnəst praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 含工資十五塊，這價格很實在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. Also, my front brake squeaks like crazy.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ˈɔlsoʊ maɪ frʌnt breɪk skwiks laɪk ˈkreɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 好。還有，我的前煞車叫得很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually just dust. Want me to adjust it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli dʒʌst dʌst wɑnt mi tə əˈdʒʌst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 通常只是灰塵。要我幫你調一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. And maybe a full tune-up too?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz ənd ˈmeɪbi ə fʊl ˈtunˌʌp tu/
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩了。順便做全車保養可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tune-up is forty-five. Do you want that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtunˌʌp ɪz ˈfɔrti faɪv du ju wɑnt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 全車保養是四十五塊。你要一起送嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... how long will all of this take, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ɔl əv ðɪs teɪk ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……那這全部做完要多久呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days, unless the part doesn't arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz ənˈlɛs ðə pɑrt ˈdʌzənt əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 兩天，除非那個零件沒送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you need a part? Which one, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ju nid ə pɑrt wɪtʃ wʌn ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 等等，還要換零件？到底是哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A brake cable. It's frayed near the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə breɪk ˈkeɪbəl ɪs freɪd nɪr ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 一條煞車線，靠近輪子的地方都磨開毛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Is it safe to ride it home today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ɪt seɪf tə raɪd ɪt hoʊm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我今天騎回家安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not with that cable. We can deliver it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wɪð ðæt ˈkeɪbəl wi kən dɪˈlɪvər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那條線不行，不過我們可以幫你送到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that saves me a trip. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðæt seɪvz mi ə trɪp θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那就省得我跑一趟。謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. I'll text you when it's done.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz aɪl tɛkst ju wɛn ɪts dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，好了我就傳訊息給你。
